# hypereffect

> A small protocol for server-guided, reactive interfaces rendered natively anywhere. The server sends elements (18 fixed components), signals (JSON state, merge-patched) and CEL expressions; the renderer sends actions back.

## Docs

- [Writing a server](https://hypereffect.dev/server-guide.md): language-agnostic guidelines: messages, update rules, server-confirmed state, and how the Rust, Go, Python and TypeScript libraries expose them.
- [Complex interfaces in Rust](https://hypereffect.dev/rust-vtree-guide.md): building the interface as a tree with the `vtree` module and sending only diffs, with a complete tested example.
- [Components](https://hypereffect.dev/components.md): all eighteen components, their attributes, defaults, nesting rules and handlers.
- [Specification](https://hypereffect.dev/spec.html)
- [Expressions](https://hypereffect.dev/expressions.html)
